data.name: イツワリの令嬢少年
data.detailed_description:
This game supports Japanese only.Fan localizations are welcome.*No permission or confirmation is required for localization, but if you contact us after completion, we will introduce it to you.

Liz, a boy living as a noble lady for the sake of a political marriage, harbors an unrequited love for the maid Nymph.On the day before the wedding, he wishes for happiness with Nymph upon the “black rose in which a fairy that grants wishes dwells,” which he has received from his fiancé Crest.

You become the “black rose fairy” and act to grant Liz’s wish, but eventually learn the fact that you were once human.

While exploring the mansion from a first-person perspective, you enter the bodies of various unique characters, view their memories, and search for your own identity.

The fate of the noble boy. The true nature of the fairy. And the hidden truth――.

Your choices will lead to three destinies: “True End,” “Bad End,” and “Game Over (Normal Bad End).”The play time is approximately up to one hour.

◆About this game

You become the "Black Rose Fairy" and explore the mansion from a first-person perspective, conversing with the unique characters and working to fulfill the young lady's wish. You can also enter the bodies of the people in the mansion and trace their memories to find clues to your true identity. As you explore the mansion and converse with the people, you progress through the text-based story, and ultimately your actions will lead to one of three possible fates.

Endings: 3 (True Ending, Bad Ending, Game Over (Normal Bad Ending))
Estimated Playtime: 1-2 hours
Production Period: 3 years (Individual Production)
Production Engine: RPG Developer Bakin

◆ Controls

WASD・・・Move

WASD + Shift・・・Dash movement

Left Mouse Click, Enter Key・・・Confirm, Examine

Right Mouse Click・・・Cancel

Mouse Movement・・・Camera Control

Mouse Wheel・・・Zoom In / Zoom Out

Esc Key, Middle Mouse Click・・・Menu

◆ “The False Lady and the Black Rose” – Guidelines for Derivative Works and Streaming

Allowed without permission or notification

  • Let’s Plays, gameplay videos, and live streams

  • All forms of fan creations (illustrations, comics, videos, novels, music, etc.)

  • Commissioned fan art and other paid derivative works

  • Reviews, analyses, and promotional content in text or video form

  • Use of official illustrations, in-game screenshots, and captured footage

    • If your content includes major story spoilers, please include spoiler warnings or masking for viewer consideration.

Prohibited activities

  • Defamation or slander toward the game or its creators

  • Publicly revealing major plot spoilers without warning

    • Example: showing the true ending or major twist directly in thumbnails or titles without spoiler tags

  • Activities beyond reasonable community standards

    • Example: selling merchandise using official artwork without permission, redistributing game files, etc.
